baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction joins لِنَجْعَلَهَا directly to تَذْكِرَةً.
baseline_models.mechanism: An opaque antecedent is intentionally changed into mnemonic form for the addressees; remembering is designed as the result of making, rather than left as an accidental reaction.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing into a state supplies the deliberate conversion of the antecedent into mnemonic form.
A reminder as that which causes recollection supplies the intended mnemonic state and purpose.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely labels an unspecified thing a reminder.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents remembrance as a deliberately produced afterlife for an antecedent: it is made into something that can keep acting on later hearers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root governs the act تَعِيَهَا and the defining adjective وَاعِيَةٌ around أُذُنٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Receptive hearing admits the reminder, inward retention keeps its meaning, and the repeated awareness root defines the ear by successful custody rather than by exposure to sound alone.

activation_trace.role: Listening with acceptance supplies the receptive threshold through which the reminder is admitted.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies durable inward custody and makes awareness the result of retained meaning.
Bringing something to mind while preserving it supplies the temporal work performed after hearing.

changed_reading.before: An attentive ear hears a reminder.
changed_reading.after: An ear counts as aware only when reception becomes inward preservation; the verse distinguishes acoustic contact from mnemonic custody.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The physical أُذُنٌ is coupled to the twofold container-capable root in تَعِيَهَا ... وَاعِيَةٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ear functions as an entry fitting while awareness functions as an inward vessel: the reminder passes from an external made form into a bounded human repository.

activation_trace.role: The bodily ear and ear-like handle or loop supply the material entry fitting for the container analogy.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the enclosing action and the inward repository that prevents loss.
Changing something into a new state supplies the preparation of mnemonic cargo for inward containment.

changed_reading.before: The ear is simply the organ named as listener.
changed_reading.after: The ear is the fitting of a nested mnemonic vessel: it admits what awareness encloses and carries without letting the reminder dissipate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated و ع ي form can retain both inward comprehension and the branch image of a fracture knitting back together.
baseline_models.mechanism: A reminder does more than store a fragment; by being retained it can reconnect a break in personal or collective continuity, as a bone regains cohesion after fracture.

activation_trace.role: Bone knitting after a break supplies a cautious material model for awareness restoring severed continuity.
The thing that prompts recollection supplies the joining piece by which a broken sequence can be recovered.

changed_reading.before: Remembering preserves an already continuous account.
changed_reading.after: Remembering may repair continuity after rupture by rejoining a lost event to present awareness; this remains a branch-mediated, exploratory material analogy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening names a reality that warrants preservation, asks what can make it known, and then names a blow that strikes the hearer; the focus answers that epistemic pressure with a deliberately made reminder whose impact must pass into retained understanding.

activation_trace.role: A reality that must be preserved supplies the durable epistemic object at stake in the reminder.
Knowledge and learned apprehension supply the unresolved epistemic demand posed before the historical examples.
A rebuke that strikes the hearer supplies the event's forceful contact with its audience.
A thing made to prompt recollection supplies the transmissible answer to the demand for knowledge.
Retaining meaning inwardly supplies the completion of a strike that would otherwise remain momentary impact.

structural_cues: The title-like noun is repeated three times, with the third occurrence inside a question about being made to know.
The focus converts an extended sequence of examples into a purpose clause and then names a successful receiver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservable reality, knowing, a hearer-striking rebuke, reminder, and retention; I infer the arrow impact -> reception -> durable knowledge. The live alternative is that the striking term only names the event and that verse 12 offers admonition without answering the opening epistemic question.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is a general retrospective admonition.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is an epistemic interface: a reality first posed as beyond ordinary knowing becomes a hearer-striking form that awareness can preserve.

context_deltas.mechanism: Impact and shrilling sound saturate the scene, while the focus root itself can name both clamor and inward retention; the aware ear is therefore not the ear exposed to the loudest signal but the one that converts acoustic assault into kept meaning.

activation_trace.role: One thing striking another supplies the abrupt physical impact that reaches a hearer.
Shrill or repeated sound supplies the scene's acoustic excess and the raw signal needing interpretation.
Raised voices and clamor supply the noisy pole internal to the same root inventory as awareness.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies the discriminating pole that turns noise into intelligible memory.
Attentive and accepting hearing supplies the selective threshold between mere loudness and received warning.

structural_cues: A named striking event is followed by a wind whose description has an explicit sound branch.
The focus singles out one kind of ear after a context full of overwhelming force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact, shrilling sound, clamor, receptive hearing, and inward retention; I supply the filtering arrow by which the ear extracts warning from noise. Alternatively, the sound imagery may only intensify destruction and have no contrastive relation to awareness.

changed_reading.before: The aware ear is simply more attentive than other ears.
changed_reading.after: The aware ear performs semantic discrimination under acoustic pressure: it converts a striking, clamorous signal into meaning that can remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destroyed communities are characterized by repudiation and departure from obedience to a message; against that failure, the focus ear's receptive-hearing branch makes awareness ethical as well as cognitive: it receives, accepts, and keeps what denial refuses.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood to a thing or speaker supplies active repudiation rather than mere ignorance.
Departure from obedience supplies the behavioral consequence of refusing what was heard.
Messenger and message supply the communicative object toward which refusal or reception is directed.
Listening that includes acceptance and obedient hearing supplies the ethical inverse of repudiation.
Keeping meaning inwardly supplies durable uptake after the initial act of acceptance.

structural_cues: Denial introduces the ruined peoples, and explicit disobedience to a messenger closes the historical sequence before the saving flood scene.
The focus praises a receiver rather than merely repeating the content of the message.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repudiation, disobedience, message, accepting hearing, and retention; I infer the arrow reception -> acceptance -> durable obedience. The live alternative is that أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ denotes cognitive memory only, without an implied behavioral response.

changed_reading.before: Awareness is a superior capacity to understand and remember.
changed_reading.after: Awareness is the opposite of historical repudiation: an ear becomes aware by accepting the message deeply enough for it to govern memory and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience is made to look at fallen, hollow bodies and then challenged to find any remainder; the focus relocates survival from visible bodies to an invisible inward deposit, so the reminder is what remains when its material bearers do not.

activation_trace.role: Bodily sight and insight supply the external inspection of ruined bodies and its invitation to reflection.
An emptied interior supplies the material image of bodies or trunks that can no longer hold life or history.
A remainder left from a thing supplies the explicit question of what, if anything, survives destruction.
Enclosing something in a vessel supplies an inward place where a nonmaterial remainder can survive.
The thing that causes recollection supplies the surviving residue of people whose visible remainder has vanished.

structural_cues: The two consecutive visual prompts move from seeing hollow fallen forms to failing to see any remainder.
The focus later names an inwardly retaining ear rather than another visible monument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, hollow interiors, absence of remainder, container-retention, and reminder; I infer a transfer from material survival to mnemonic survival. Alternatively, the focus may commemorate rescue alone, without presenting memory as the destroyed peoples' remainder.

changed_reading.before: The reminder points back to destroyed peoples as an example.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is itself the surviving remainder: awareness becomes the interior monument that persists precisely where bodies, trunks, and visible traces are emptied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflowing water is answered by people being carried in a moving vessel, and the focus immediately turns that rescue into mnemonic cargo; the outer carrier preserves persons through water while the aware inner vessel preserves the rescue through time.

activation_trace.role: Water rising into overwhelming force supplies the environment in which containment becomes preservative rather than merely spatial.
Lifting and carrying a visible load supplies the rescue vessel's preservation of embodied passengers.
Flowing movement supplies the mobile carrier that bears its contents through the destructive medium.
Turning a thing into a new state supplies the conversion of rescued history into mnemonic cargo.
Putting a thing in a vessel supplies the inward carrier that preserves the rescue after the physical vessel is gone.
A reminder that reactivates memory supplies the cargo transferred from physical survival to intergenerational awareness.

structural_cues: The carrying-in-the-vessel clause directly precedes the purpose clause لِنَجْعَلَهَا, making the feminine pronoun a live link to the rescue, vessel, or event.
The focus repeats the container-capable awareness root as both act and quality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, physical carrying, a moving vessel, deliberate mnemonic transformation, and inward containment; I infer the analogy outer carrier -> inner carrier and the transfer persons -> remembered event. The alternative is that وَعْي is only cognitive retention and that the vessel image does not continue materially into verse 12.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks later listeners to remember an earlier rescue.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a second rescue: as the vessel carried lives through flood, the aware ear carries the rescue as mnemonic cargo through historical loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, air is sent into a horn in one convergent blast; the ear that has learned to receive and retain past warning becomes a faculty oriented toward the future summons as well as an archive of the past.

activation_trace.role: Sending air into a thing supplies the production of the signal that follows the focus ear.
The horn of blowing supplies the acoustic instrument and the future summons toward which hearing can be oriented.
Things united in one direction supply the single blast's convergent, non-diffuse demand on hearers.
Attentive, accepting hearing supplies the prepared receptor for a summons rather than a merely anatomical ear.
Retained meaning supplies continuity between remembered warning and readiness for its future realization.

structural_cues: The focus ear is followed immediately by فَإِذَا and a single blast, creating a sharp shift from preserved history to future event.
The next verse repeats وَاحِدَةٌ for the single crushing, reinforcing concentrated rather than diffuse action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a receptive ear, retained warning, air sent into a horn, and one convergent blast; I infer the arrow remembered warning -> readiness for summons. The alternative is purely sequential: the blast begins a new scene without the focus ear anticipating it.

changed_reading.before: The aware ear archives a completed historical rescue.
changed_reading.after: The aware ear is both archive and readiness organ: preserving past warning conditions the hearer to receive the singular future summons as meaningful rather than sudden noise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth and mountains are leveled, the sky splits, and its fabric weakens; against this sequence of broken cohesion, the focus awareness branch of bone knitting supports a counter-motion in which remembrance reconnects meaning even when the world's structures come apart.

activation_trace.role: Pounding and demolition until level supply the destruction of previously stable material form.
Splitting open supplies explicit cosmic fracture and loss of enclosure.
A tear or rupture in a skin, cloth, or waterskin supplies the image of a containing fabric that can no longer hold.
Bone healing after fracture supplies the opposed material motion of regained cohesion.
A reminder that restores recollection supplies the semantic material by which severed continuity can be rejoined.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence moves from crushing to a fallen event to a split and weakened sky.
The focus's repeated awareness root sits just before this sustained vocabulary of structural failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leveling, splitting, a torn container, bone knitting, and reminder; I infer the counter-arrow cosmic rupture -> mnemonic repair. A materially live alternative is that the bone-healing branch is a remote lexical association and that awareness here means retention without repair imagery.

changed_reading.before: Memory stores a representation of rupture.
changed_reading.after: Memory performs a limited counter-work to rupture: it cannot preserve the old structures, but it can knit their meaning back into human continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same carrying root brackets the focus in three materially different scenes: people are carried to preservation, earth and mountains are carried to crushing, and the throne is carried as an entrusted weight; the focus inserts an inward carrying that preserves meaning and discriminates what kind of burden survives.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a visible load supplies the preservative transport of people immediately before the focus.
Carrying a visible load supplies transport toward demolition and shows that carrying alone does not guarantee preservation.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies a moralized form of carrying for the later throne-bearing scene.
Enclosing and carrying contents in a vessel supplies the focus's inward member of the repeated carrier chain.
Keeping meaning in the heart specifies that the inward load is intelligible remembrance rather than physical weight.

structural_cues: ح م ل recurs immediately before the focus and twice after it, with preservation, demolition, and throne-bearing as distinct outcomes.
The focus is the only point in the sequence where carrying becomes explicitly inward and mnemonic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three repeated acts of carrying plus awareness as inward containment; I infer that the recurrence frames remembrance as entrusted carrying and that outcome depends on what and how one carries. The alternative is ordinary verbal recurrence with no designed relation to the focus's retention root.

changed_reading.before: Awareness is a static container that stores a reminder.
changed_reading.after: Awareness is an active bearer within a larger carrier chain: it accepts the entrusted weight of history and transports meaning where physical loads may be saved, crushed, or upheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: A truth requiring preservation is made into a deed-like reminder, retained after public notification, and later correlated with an occurrence that bears a written trace and a universal exposure that removes concealment; private memory thus acquires an evidentiary horizon.

activation_trace.role: A truth whose reality must be preserved supplies the claim that the mnemonic record is meant to keep.
A written signature and its trace supply an exploratory image of occurrence leaving an attestable mark.
Bringing something forth for inspection supplies the later venue in which retained evidence becomes publicly present.
Removing concealment and making visible supplies the disclosure condition under which no inward record remains hidden.
A deed or document of right supplies the reminder's exploratory status as preserved testimony rather than private sentiment.
Knowledge made public by announcement supplies the movement from proclaimed warning to an accountable receiver.
Keeping meaning inwardly supplies custody of the testimony between announcement and exposure.

structural_cues: The window opens with named reality, places the reminder at its center, and ends with universal presentation and the negation of anything hidden.
The repeated event language moves from warning about an event to the event occurring before exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservable truth, a written-trace branch, display, unveiling, a deed-like reminder, announcement, and inward custody; I infer the juridical arrow proclamation -> deposited testimony -> exposure. The alternative is that the document and signature branches are only associative side-images and that the reminder remains admonitory rather than evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The reminder privately helps a listener recollect a warning.
changed_reading.after: The reminder can be carried as deposited testimony: announced truth is retained now because both occurrence and receiver later stand exposed without concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus plainly names the bodily ear, while the same branch also includes ear-like handles and loops; it remains anchored by أُذُنٌ beside the container branch of both و ع ي forms. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for attachment and admission, not as a lexical replacement for 'ear.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أُذُنٌ stands between the act and adjective of و ع ي, allowing the ear/handle image to meet the vessel image without leaving the focus construction.

activation_trace.role: The physical ear and ear-like handle or loop supply an attachment point through which a vessel can be grasped or accessed.
Putting contents in a vessel supplies the repository to which the ear-like fitting gives access.

changed_reading.before: The ear is a passive opening through which sound passes.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the ear is the handle or fitting by which a person takes hold of mnemonic cargo and admits it to an inward vessel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because تَرَى is visually used in context, but its split mapping exposes a non-dominant branch of transmitting report or poetry; it remains valid as an activation because the repeated visual prompts meet a focus reminder retained by an ear. It must be rendered as a split-root associative switch from vanished sight to surviving report, never as the contextual gloss of تَرَى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus turns a prior inspectable scene into تَذْكِرَةً that an ear retains, directly supporting a transition from sight to report-memory.

activation_trace.role: Transmitting report or poetry supplies the non-dominant split-root route by which a seen scene can persist as narrated account.
A thing that prompts recollection supplies the report's continuing mnemonic effect after the scene vanishes.
Retaining meaning in the heart supplies the receiver in whom transmitted report outlasts direct sight.

changed_reading.before: The audience is asked to inspect visible ruins and remember what it sees.
changed_reading.after: Once no visible remainder can be found, report takes over from sight: the aware ear preserves a narrated remainder that the eye can no longer inspect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because فَوْقَهُمْ is spatial in its source, while B005 is a side-image of awareness, strength, or rest returning; it remains anchored by the focus's doubled و ع ي and by its placement after cosmic rupture and weakness. Downstream prose should mark it as branch-activated resonance, not claim that 'above' means consciousness here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَعِيَهَا ... وَاعِيَةٌ explicitly names awareness two times, giving the later return-of-awareness branch a direct focus landing point.

activation_trace.role: The return of awareness, strength, or rest supplies a recovery image after the context's splitting and weakness.
Healing and regaining strength after fracture supply the focus-side process through which awareness can return.
Inwardly retained meaning supplies the content recovered when awareness returns rather than an empty recovery of sensation.

changed_reading.before: An aware ear possesses a stable trait of consciousness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, awareness is also a recovery event: after overwhelming rupture, retained meaning is what lets consciousness and coherence return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus use of وَاعِيَةٌ ordinarily concerns retention, not guardianship of an orphan, and the contextual carrying is physical; it remains anchored by the caretaker branch of the exact doubled focus root and the adjacent carrying scene. Render only as a social analogy in which inherited memory is a vulnerable charge, not as a lexical gloss or claim about an actual orphan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The aware ear is grammatically defined by taking charge of the feminine object هَا, which permits a cautious guardianship model for the remembered event.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a trust or burden supplies the contextual transfer of preservation into moral responsibility.
The caretaker responsible for an orphan supplies a social image of sustained guardianship for vulnerable mnemonic cargo.
The reminder that keeps an absent matter recallable supplies the vulnerable charge entrusted to the caretaker-ear.

changed_reading.before: The listener owns a memory for personal benefit.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social analogy, the listener is entrusted with a vulnerable inherited memory and must keep it alive on behalf of those who cannot carry it themselves.

strongest_changes: The rescue vessel and the inward container form two carriers: one preserves lives through water, the other preserves the rescue through time.
Denial and disobedience revise receptive hearing from a cognitive skill into accepting, ethically consequential uptake.
Hollow bodies and the absence of a visible remainder make the reminder itself an inward surviving remainder.
Final exposure activates an evidentiary reading in which announced truth is retained as testimony rather than private recollection alone.
The post-focus blast and cosmic fracture add two coexisting horizons: readiness for a future summons and mnemonic repair amid structural unmaking.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a transfer hinge: event becomes reminder, outer vessel becomes inner vessel, overwhelming sound becomes retained meaning, vanished bodies become mnemonic remainder, and private custody can become exposable testimony. Split and branch-distant cues also kept live a report-after-sight reading, an awareness-as-recovery reading, and a caretaker model without displacing the stronger reception and containment mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent of هَا can be the vessel, the carrying rescue, or the wider event, and each scope slightly changes the vessel analogy.
The causal arrows from remembered warning to obedience and future readiness are reader-supplied; the packet also permits merely sequential relations.
The repair, signature, caretaker, handle, and return-of-awareness readings depend on branch-distant images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The report-after-sight outlier depends on the non-dominant ر ء ي -> ر و ي mapping and must not be presented as the contextual sense of تَرَى.
